component.name: mRemoteNG
component.summary: Manage SSH, Telnet, SFTP and FTP connections in one window

description.p: mRemoteNG for Linux keeps your remote connections in a tree and opens them in tabs: SSH, Telnet, raw TCP and local terminal sessions, and SFTP and FTP/FTPS file transfers.

Its connection files are those of mRemoteNG for Windows, so a team can share one file between Windows and Linux, including its encrypted passwords. SSH uses OpenSSH, so your ssh_config, keys, agent and known_hosts apply.
This is a community port of mRemoteNG to Linux; it is not made by the mRemoteNG project.

First beta release: connection files shared with Windows mRemoteNG 1.77 and later; SSH, Telnet, raw TCP and local terminal sessions; SFTP and FTP/FTPS file transfer; a look that follows mRemoteNG for Windows.
